mentions.name: Financial Web Tools
mentions.description: This project provides free, snappy web-based financial planning tools covering retirement planning, budgeting, debt paydown, and house hacking. The tools show quickly and visually how changing variables such as interest rates, savings rates, and inflation impact the user's financial positioning, and require no contact information to get results.
mentions.problem: Most financial planning tools online are overly simplistic, non-responsive, and/or require handing over a bunch of contact information before getting results.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on some free financial planning tools at:  https://financialwebtools.com/
